name: Rockville SPGN154 15" Passive 1600W DJ PA Speaker ABS Lightweight Cabinet 4 Ohm
description: Rockville SPGN154 15" Passive 1600 Watt 4 Ohm Lightweight DJ PA ABS Cabinet Speaker. Power Handling: 400 Watts RMS / 800 Watts Program Power / 1600 Watts Peak. High power long-throw 15" woofer with 3" aluminum voice coil provides incredibly deep bass and acoustic power. High-power 2-way pro sound reinforcement speaker system for live sound and play back applications. Compact and light weight system delivers distortion free sound even at extreme SPL. State-of-the-art 1.35" Japanese made pure titanium-diaphragm compression driver for crystal clear high-frequency reproduction. Twist-Lock speakon input and output connections. Stage floor or stand mounting with 35-mm pole socket. Ultra-wide dispersion, 40° large-format horizontal wave guide horn molded directly into the cabinet. Versatile trapezoidal enclosure design allows different positioning. Tilts on its side for use as a floor monitor. Ergonomically shaped handle for easy carrying and setup. High-quality components and exceptionally rugged high impact ABS construction. Impedance: 4 Ohms. Frequency Response: 35Hz-20KHz. Maximum SPL @1w/1m: 128dB peak / 125dB continuous.

name: Serato DJ Pro Download), Performance Software
description: 64-Bit Support for Better Performance, Support for High-Resolution Screens, Practice Mode: Works with No Hardware, Plug-and-Play with Several Manufacturers, Intuitive Design, Sampler: Trigger Up to 32 Samples, Trigger Cues and Loops, High-Quality FX from iZotope, Optional Expansion Packs Available, Organize Tracks from iTunes Library Serato DJ Pro is an integrated software and hardware system designed to give music selectors and DJs powerful control over their music library. Using the Serato DJ Pro software you can DJ music on your computer with accurate control from a range of Serato supported hardware. Simply connect your Serato DJ Hardware to your computer connect to your sound system and you're in action. Serato DJ Pro works with a variety of supported controllers including models from Akai Allen & Heath Denon DJ Numark Novation Roland Pioneer Rane Reloop and Vestax. The software's functionality includes a number of improvements including a full-featured 2-deck Practice Mode 64-bit support for better performance and stability support for high-resolution screens a refreshed UI and an improved help & support section in-app. Practice Mode allows you to mix two tracks together with no hardware connected which is ideal for testing out your blends wherever you are while the 64-bit support features virtually no limit on library size allowing a huge number of crates and thousands of songs all with fast search and loading. The Performance Pad view allows your cue points to be displayed in a familiar layout for streamlined planning and performance routines. The updated display is compatible with Retina 4K and UHD displays with Hi-DPI screen support and a scalable interface. There are several add-on expansion packs for exciting elements and performance boosting features including Flip Video DVS P'NT DJ FX and Remote. Flip allows you to create save and playback custom edits of your tracks while Video allows you to add and control video with in-depth effects and transitions.
